CDS Protocol T - Cancer Adjunct

Protocol cds protocol cancer adjunct

Evidence: Grade C (scientific)

Summary

Cancer adjunct protocol using supportive CDS dosing alongside conventional cancer treatment.

Indications

  • Cancer support
  • Adjunct therapy
  • Tumor support
  • Systemic support

Steps

  1. Consult oncology team
  2. Prepare adjunct dose
  3. Follow supportive schedule
  4. Monitor for interactions
  5. Coordinate care

Dosage

Cancer adjunct protocol: 1-2 ml CDS in 100ml water, 2 times daily

Expected Outcomes

  • Cancer support
  • Adjunct therapy
  • Systemic support
  • Immune support

Monitoring

  • Monitor cancer treatment
  • Track side effects
  • Coordinate with oncology
  • Watch for interactions

Frequency: 2 times daily
